title: Payment step 6 — settlement verification: debited amount_in, not max_amount_in
description: 600,000 CRC before, 599,457.25 after: a net debit of exactly amount_in. Had the residue not returned, the balance would show a debit of max_amount_in and the payer would be 5.43 CRC short.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway, spoke-crc. This single assertion is the difference between a settlement test and an API test. 600000000000000000000000 - 542753802533140547183 = 599457246197466859452817.
